SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period 
FROM dim_date 
WHERE fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3) 
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period 
LIMIT 10;

SELECT MAX(calendar_date) as max_date, MAX(fiscal_year) as latest_fiscal_year
FROM dim_date;

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as transaction_count,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;

WITH period_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        d.fiscal_year,
        d.fiscal_period,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as transaction_count,
        SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
        AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
    fiscal_period,
    transaction_count,
    ROUND(total_net_sales / transaction_count, 2) as atv
FROM period_summary
ORDER BY fiscal_period;

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    f.channel_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as transaction_count,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_code
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_code;

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.channel_code IS NOT NULL THEN f.channel_code
        WHEN f.channel_id = 1 THEN 'ST'
        WHEN f.channel_id IN (2, 3) THEN 'WB'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END as channel,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as transaction_count,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, 
    CASE 
        WHEN f.channel_code IS NOT NULL THEN f.channel_code
        WHEN f.channel_id = 1 THEN 'ST'
        WHEN f.channel_id IN (2, 3) THEN 'WB'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, channel;

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as transactions,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.receipt_id END) as staff_purchase_receipts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN NULL ELSE f.receipt_id END) as regular_receipts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as total_receipts
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    'All sales' as category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as transactions,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, 'All sales'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    'Excluding staff' as category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as transactions,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
    AND (f.staff_purchase_flag IS NULL OR f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, 'Excluding staff'
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, category;

-- Final query for ATV by period
SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) as net_sales,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
    AND (f.staff_purchase_flag IS NULL OR f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;

-- Verify web orders are included
SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.channel_code IS NOT NULL THEN f.channel_code
        WHEN f.channel_id = 1 THEN 'ST'
        WHEN f.channel_id IN (2, 3) THEN 'WB'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END as channel,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) as net_sales,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
    AND (f.staff_purchase_flag IS NULL OR f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, 
    CASE 
        WHEN f.channel_code IS NOT NULL THEN f.channel_code
        WHEN f.channel_id = 1 THEN 'ST'
        WHEN f.channel_id IN (2, 3) THEN 'WB'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, channel;

-- Check for any negative amounts or unusual patterns
SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    COUNT(*) as line_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN f.net_amount < 0 THEN 1 END) as negative_lines,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN f.net_amount = 0 THEN 1 END) as zero_amount_lines,
    MIN(f.net_amount) as min_amount,
    MAX(f.net_amount) as max_amount
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
    AND (f.staff_purchase_flag IS NULL OR f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;
